_comment: BLOCKER 3 -- THE UNARMED RUN, exactly as the workflow produced it when OTC_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / OTC_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY were absent: '--lanes __unarmed__ --no-ledger' meant NO lane matched the filter and the ledger block was dropped, so the run evaluated only the five credential-free platform surfaces, found them all healthy, and exited 0. As scheduled TODAY that is what it would have reported every six hours: OK, while checking neither a lane, nor a ring, nor the ledger -- the precise failure class it exists to detect, wearing a green light. This fixture MUST NOT exit 0. It carries no lane, no ledger and no retrieval block on purpose; the coverage assertion is what turns it non-zero (REDUCED, exit 3).
